slides.title: Welcome to CSS Typography
slides.content:
# CSS Typography ✍️

Typography is over 90% of the web! Great typography guides reader attention, conveys brand tone, and dramatically elevates user experience.

## What you'll master:
- 🔤 **Font Families** - Web-safe fonts, generic fallbacks, and Google Fonts
- 📏 **Font Sizing & Fluid Scaling** - `rem` units and modern `clamp()` fluid type
- ⚖️ **Font Styling** - `font-weight`, `font-style`, and variable fonts
- 📐 **Text Flow & Spacing** - `line-height`, `letter-spacing`, and `word-spacing`
- 🎯 **Alignment & Text Truncation** - `text-align`, `text-transform`, and `text-overflow: ellipsis`

slides.title: Font Families and Fallbacks
slides.content:
# Font Families (`font-family`) 🔠

The `font-family` property defines a prioritized list of font names:

```css_not
body {
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
}
```

## How the Font Stack Works:
1. The browser checks if the user has the first font installed.
2. If not, it moves to the next font in the comma-separated list.
3. The final item should **always** be a generic font family name!

## Generic Font Families:
- `sans-serif`: Modern clean fonts without decorative serifs (e.g. Arial, Inter).
- `serif`: Traditional fonts with decorative serifs (e.g. Times New Roman, Georgia).
- `monospace`: Equal character widths for code (e.g. Courier, Fira Code).
- `system-ui`: Native operating system UI font.

slides.title: Importing Web Fonts with @font-face
Font Sizing (font-size)
slides.content:
# Font Sizing (`font-size`) 📏

Set typography size with relative units:

```css_not
html {
  font-size: 16px; /* Base size */
}

h1 { font-size: 2.5rem; } /* 40px */
h2 { font-size: 2rem; }   /* 32px */
h3 { font-size: 1.5rem; } /* 24px */
p  { font-size: 1rem; }   /* 16px */
small { font-size: 0.875rem; } /* 14px */
```

Font Weights & Styles
slides.content:
# Font Weight & Style ⚖️

## `font-weight`:
Controls how thick or thin the letterforms render.

| Numeric Weight | Keyword | Common Use |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `300` | Light | Subtle captions |
| `400` | Normal | Standard body text |
| `500` | Medium | Navigation links |
| `600` | Semi-Bold | Subheadings |
| `700` | Bold | Main headings |
| `800` / `900` | Extra Bold / Black | Heavy hero titles |

```css_not
.hero-title {
  font-weight: 800;
  font-style: italic;
}
```

slides.title: Letter Spacing and Word Spacing
Text Transformations & Decorations
slides.content:
# Text Transformations & Decorations 🎨

## `text-transform`:
Changes capitalization without altering the HTML source text:
```css_not
.uppercase { text-transform: uppercase; }  /* HELLO */
.lowercase { text-transform: lowercase; }  /* hello */
.capitalize { text-transform: capitalize; } /* Hello World */
```

## `text-decoration`:
Underlines, strikethroughs, and color accents:
```css_not
a {
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-color: #3b82f6;
  text-decoration-thickness: 2px;
  text-underline-offset: 4px; /* Pulls underline down away from text descenders */
}
```

slides.title: Accessible Typography Checklist
slides.content:
# Accessible Typography Checklist ♿

Follow these accessibility standards for text:
1. **Minimum contrast:** Body text must have at least `4.5:1` contrast ratio against its background.
2. **Avoid tiny text:** Body text should be at least `1rem` (16px).
3. **Limit line length:** Ideal line length is 45 to 75 characters (`max-width: 65ch;`).
4. **Adequate line spacing:** Keep body line-height at least `1.5`.
5. **Never disable user zoom:** Never use `user-scalable=no` in viewport meta.

Summary & Next Steps
slides.content:
# Typography Mastered! ✍️

You now wield full command over typography scales, font stacks, and readability!

## Key Takeaways:
- ✅ **Font Stacks:** Always end with generic fallbacks (`sans-serif`, `serif`, `monospace`).
- ✅ **Units:** Use `rem` for accessibility and `clamp()` for fluid responsive sizing.
- ✅ **Line Height:** Always declare unitless line-height (`1.5` - `1.6` for body text).
- ✅ **Line Length:** Constrain paragraph widths with `max-width: 65ch`.
- ✅ **Truncation:** Combine `white-space: nowrap`, `overflow: hidden`, and `text-overflow: ellipsis`.
